content: Rahul Jain contacted agent Ramesh Tiwari regarding policy AU-45219 showing as expired. Rahul confirmed he sold his car and wanted to cancel the policy permanently. Ramesh processed the cancellation, provided the receipt, and confirmed Rahul is eligible for a prorated refund of ₹4,500 to be credited within 5-7 business days.

action_items: Credit prorated refund of ₹4,500 to customer bank account within 5-7 business days
